material_type.evidence: The I27E24C–K55C monomer samples were prepared by diluting 20 μl of protein (0.5 μg μl−1) in 20 μl PBS pH 7.4 containing L-cysteine, homocysteine and N-acetyl cysteine at the same concentration as used in the single molecule experiments.

sample_source.evidence: The engineered polyproteins and the I27E24C–K55C monomer (synthetic gene, Thermo Fisher Scientific) were then cloned into the pQE80L (Qiagen) expression vector, and transformed into the BLR(DE3) Escherichia coli expression strain (VWR International).
